headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest revenue increases.
summary: Coforge led revenue growth with a 53.6% YoY jump and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech delivered double‑digit profit growth on strong AI revenue. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% as growth slowed to 1.5% YoY. Wipro posted revenue growth but a 1.9% profit decline, reflecting margin pressure.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin and guidance pressure
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; Wipro introduced modest sequential guidance, indicating caution on margins.

themes.title: Dividend payouts
themes.detail: Companies continued to return cash, with Infosys, LTM and HCLTech declaring or maintaining dividends.
